# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-22

### Added
- Initial release
- UUID v4 generation via `crypto.randomUUID()`
- Nano-ID generation via `crypto.randomFillSync()` (zero extra dependencies)
- Custom generator function support
- Configurable response header name (default `X-Request-ID`)
- Incoming request-ID support with allowlist-based validation
- Configurable ID prefix
- `exposeHeader` toggle
- `createRequestIdGenerator()` standalone factory
- `validateRequestId()` public export
- Comprehensive test suite (Vitest + Supertest)
- ESLint configuration
- Usage examples for basic, custom header, incoming ID, and custom generator scenarios
